messages.content: Hi, Northline Care here for your check-in this week. What's your glucose or BP reading?
My numbers been high. Glucose was 245 this morning on my meter.
Got it, logging that now. That's elevated for you, so I'm connecting you with a nurse too. She should call within about 31 hours to go over what's happening.
Is it something I need to handle right now? I'm out in the field right now.
Your nurse can best answer that when she calls you. I can't give medical advice, but this is flagged so she will prioritize it. Did you take your meds this morning like usual?
Yeah got my metformin in me. Also gotta ask—can you refill my glipizide? I'm low
I'll note the refill request for your nurse—I can't process refills myself but she can help or connect you with your pharmacy. Next check-in for us is next week, same time. Sound good?

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
